birthday_sms.name: birthday_sms
birthday_sms.default: 'Happy birthday, {name}! 🎉 Everyone at {church} celebrates you today. Have a blessed year!'

birthday_email_body.name: birthday_email_body
birthday_email_body.default:
'Dear {name},

Happy birthday! On behalf of the entire {church} family, we celebrate the gift of your life today. May this new year be filled with God''s blessings, joy and good health.

We love and appreciate you!'

anniversary_sms.name: anniversary_sms
anniversary_sms.default: 'Happy {occasion}, {name}! 🎊 {church} celebrates with you today. God bless you!'

anniversary_email_body.name: anniversary_email_body
anniversary_email_body.default:
'Dear {name},

Congratulations on your {occasion}! The {church} family rejoices with you and prays God''s continued blessing over you.

With love,
{church}'

welcome_sms.name: welcome_sms
welcome_sms.default: 'Hi {name}, it was a joy to have you at {church}! 🙏 Thank you for worshipping with us. We''d love to see you again soon.'

welcome_email_body.name: welcome_email_body
welcome_email_body.default:
'Dear {name},

Thank you so much for visiting {church}! It was a joy to have you worship with us.

We''d love to stay connected and see you again. If there''s any way we can pray for you or serve you, please let us know.

With love,
{church}'

invite_sms.name: invite_sms
invite_sms.default: 'Hi {name}, we''d love for you to become part of the {church} family! Complete your membership here: {link}'

invite_email_body.name: invite_email_body
invite_email_body.default:
'Dear {name},

We''ve loved having you with us these past couple of weeks. We''d be honoured to have you become a full member of the {church} family.

It only takes a minute — just complete your details here:
{link}

We look forward to walking this journey with you.

With love,
{church}'

intro.name: intro
intro.default: 'Fill in your details below so we can stay connected with you. It only takes a minute.'

success_message.name: success_message
success_message.default: 'Thank you! Your details have been saved. We''re glad to have you.'

sms_template.name: sms_template
sms_template.default: 'Hi {name}, reminder: {service} holds {day} {time} at {church}. We can''t wait to see you!'

email_template.name: email_template
email_template.default:
'Hi {name},

This is a friendly reminder that {service} holds {day} at {time}.

We look forward to worshipping with you at {church}!'
